caveats:
This product contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2022), processed by ESA and analyzed by the Earth Observatory of Singapore.

These are preliminary maps derived from satellite radar and should be used as guidance only. Coloured pixels may include false positives, and their absence does not mean an absence of damage or flooding.
methodology_other: Change detection on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images acquired before and after the event. Damage Proxy Maps show significant changes in radar coherence and amplitude; Flood Proxy Maps show areas that changed to standing water. Maps are preliminary and checked against news reports and ground-level imagery where available.

# Philippines Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps, Jul 2022

The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Philippines Earthquake (Jul 2022) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it.

## Maps in this dataset

- **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Philippines, Lindol, 7 Agosto 2022, v0.9**
- **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Philippines, Lindol, 7 Agosto 2022, v0.9**

**More map details and files:** <https://sf.earthobservatory.sg/event/EOS-RS_202207_Philippines_Earthquake>

**Kredito:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA), NASA-JPL/Caltech, Naglalaman ng binagong Copernicus Sentinel data (2022)

organization.description: The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) is a research lab at Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore. It uses satellite remote sensing, mainly synthetic aperture radar (SAR), to map natural hazards and disasters. The lab produces Damage Proxy Maps (DPMs) and Flood Proxy Maps (FPMs) showing where damage or flooding has likely occurred. Its work focuses on Southeast Asia and the wider Asia-Pacific, and it also responds to major disasters worldwide.

title: Philippines Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps, Jul 2022

resources.description:
EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Philippines, Lindol, 7 Agosto 2022, v0.9

ZIP containing: GeoTIFF, KMZ, PNG, TXT.

Ang Earth Observatory of Singapore ay gumawa ng paunang Damage Proxy Map (DPM)) na nagpapakita ng mga lugar na maaring napinsala sa hilagang Luzon, Philippines dulot ng Mw 7.0 na lindol na nangyari noong 27 Hulyo 2022 sa Tayum, Abra. Ang mapa na ito ay nagmula sa mga synthetic aperture radar (SAR) na litrato na kuha ng Copernicus Sentinel-1 na pinapaandar ng European Space Agency (ESA) bago (9 Abril 2022 hanggang 26 Hulyo 2022) at pagkatapos (7 Agosto 2022) nang pangyayari.
